lines.en: label tsuneyosummer2ramengen:
scene tsuneyosummer2ramengen
I make my way over to one of the few sanctuaries in the seediest part of town to be greeted by the same expressionless, mechanical greeting as always.
lines.zh: 我前往城里最乌烟瘴气的地段里为数不多的几处避难所之一，迎接我的是一如既往那毫无表情、机械般的问候。

lines.en: Tsuneyo stands before me like some sort of omnipresent being who can do anything she wants, but all she {i}wants{/i} is to feed me noodles.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 站在我面前，像某种无所不在的存在，可以做任何她想做的事，可她唯一{i}想{/i}做的就是给我喂面。

lines.en: That works, though, because I...probably wouldn’t have come here if I wasn’t hungry.
lines.zh: 不过这样也行，因为我……要是不饿，大概就不会来这儿了。

lines.en: And I say that as someone who consistently comes here despite not being hungry, which is...a little strange, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: 而这话出自一个明明不饿却还是经常来这儿的人之口，现在想想……有点奇怪。

lines.en: I don’t want to say that I don’t {i}like{/i} talking to Tsuneyo. It’s just...well...you know.
lines.zh: 我不想说我不{i}喜欢{/i}跟 Tsuneyo 说话。只是……嗯……你知道的。

lines.en: There’s never really much {i}to{/i} talk about with her when everything I say goes over her head and everything {i}she{/i} says slips well under mine.
lines.zh: 跟她真的没什么{i}可聊{/i}的——我说的一切都从她头顶飞过，而{i}她{/i}说的一切都从我脚底溜走。

lines.en: But regardless, I find myself here yet again- empty stomach and empty mind. Ready to fill up on ramen and whatever strange form of “wisdom” she is willing to bestow on me this time around.
lines.zh: 但不管怎样，我又一次来到了这儿——空着肚子，也空着脑子。准备用拉面，以及这次她愿意赐予我的某种奇怪的「智慧」把自己填满。

lines.en: scene black
We talk at length about darkness and how it has always made her feel uneasy.
lines.zh: 我们长谈了黑暗，以及它一直如何让她感到不安。

lines.en: She used to keep a night light in every corner of her room to chase away the evil.
lines.zh: 她以前在房间每个角落都放一盏夜灯，用来驱赶邪恶。

lines.en: Those lights are in her father’s room now.
lines.zh: 那些灯现在在她父亲的房间里。

lines.en: She says he needs them more.
